verdict.summary: Round 5 confirms the round-4 result. The failed-gate diagnostic remains an inert, SHA-pinned artifact upload conditioned exactly on a genuine gate failure and successful bundle verification; it neither executes shell nor receives a target credential. The contents/workflows/issues/pull-request write token is minted only on the verified gate-success lane, while failed-gate follow-up filing uses a separately minted issues-only token routed exclusively to that step. The live self-tests pin the complete security-sensitive conditions, evaluate failure/success/absent verdicts with positive controls, assert exact credential consumers and permission scopes, and cover the prior mint defect without relying on substring containment. I found no blocker, major, or lower-severity defect in the diff.
